likelihood_evaluation.rule: Every dataset is evaluated against its target TDB with the ESPEI 0.9.1 likelihood functions and the TDB's own parameters (tools/espei_evaluate.py: ZPF driving forces, equilibrium-property residuals, activity residuals and likelihood, non-equilibrium likelihood). A ZPF region with a non-finite driving force is cut (`espei_evaluation_nonfinite_region`); a dataset that raises an error (e.g. a KeyError for an SER phase such as GRAPHITE or 1/2_MOLE_O2(G) that the TDB does not define), gives a non-finite value, times out, or whose TDB pycalphad cannot load is not written (`espei_evaluation_<status>`).

exclusion_reasons.mole_fractions_sum_above_one: printed tie-line mole fractions sum to more than one (rounding, e.g. 0.677 + 0.333); check_dataset rejects it; printed values are not altered
exclusion_reasons.null_in_composition: a composition with a null (not printed) entry next to printed ones (ternary vertex or condition); ESPEI 0.9.1 clean_dataset cannot convert it; values are not invented

drop_reasons.not_in_release: observation not published in the literature release (added or re-read after the release)
drop_reasons.evidence_class_mismatch: published evidence class differs from the folder's class (classes are never mixed)
drop_reasons.value_differs_from_release: dataset value differs from the published value (e.g. a quality fix applied in the release: per-formula -> per-atom basis); the dataset value is not used
drop_reasons.temperature_differs_from_release: dataset temperature differs from the published temperature
drop_reasons.composition_differs_from_release: a ZPF vertex composition is not among the published phase compositions
drop_reasons.magnitude_implausible: physically implausible magnitude for fitting (|S| > 150 J/K/mol-atom, |Cp| > 200 J/K/mol-atom, |H| or |G| > 1000 kJ/mol-atom): a unit error in the source or the extraction; the value stays in the literature release with its flags
drop_reasons.phase_rule:phase_not_printed: physical phase rule: no phase printed for the value and the caption does not name the liquid (no default phase is assigned)
drop_reasons.phase_rule:phase_label_not_mapped: physical phase rule: the printed phase label is not mapped to a model phase by the phase registry
drop_reasons.phase_rule:phase_label_ambiguous: physical phase rule: the printed label maps to several registry phases
drop_reasons.phase_rule:phase_without_tdb_model: physical phase rule: the registry phase has no TDB model
drop_reasons.phase_rule:compound_property_not_fittabl: physical phase rule: a property of a stoichiometric compound that ESPEI 0.9.1 cannot fit (only HM_FORM / SM_FORM of endmembers)
drop_reasons.phase_rule:liquid_impossible_at_T: physical phase rule: liquid printed at a temperature below the lowest possible liquid temperature of the system
drop_reasons.phase_rule:not_espei_ready: the published value is not espei_ready
drop_reasons.phase_not_in_target_tdb: the value's phase has no model in the target TDB (the assessment folder)
drop_reasons.phase_several_models_in_target_tdb: the value's registry phase has several models in the target TDB
drop_reasons.composition_not_at_compound: compound formation value whose printed composition differs from the compound's formula composition in the target TDB by more than 0.01
drop_reasons.no_unique_endmember_in_target_tdb: no single endmember of the compound's TDB model at its composition
drop_reasons.duplicate_identical_property_dataset: E3 (property datasets): identical to another dataset of the same folder and system (output, phases, conditions, values); written once, ids in `orchid.also_reported_as`
drop_reasons.espei_evaluation_nonfinite_region: ZPF region with a non-finite driving force against the target TDB (ESPEI 0.9.1 likelihood evaluation); region not written
drop_reasons.espei_evaluation_error: dataset raises an error in the ESPEI 0.9.1 likelihood evaluation against its TDB
drop_reasons.espei_evaluation_nonfinite: dataset gives a non-finite value in the ESPEI 0.9.1 likelihood evaluation
drop_reasons.espei_evaluation_tdb_error: target TDB cannot be loaded by pycalphad
drop_reasons.reference_phase_not_in_target_tdb: a reference-state phase is not a phase of the target TDB (e.g. the SER name 1/2_MOLE_O2(G), truncated to '1' by the record builder); ESPEI 0.9.1 stops with a KeyError
drop_reasons.blocked_by_flag:unsigned_in_print: the published value is flagged unsigned_in_print (minus sign absent in print; sign uncertain)
drop_reasons.blocked_by_flag:magnitude_suspect: the published value is flagged magnitude_suspect
drop_reasons.blocked_by_flag:system_mismatch: the published value is flagged system_mismatch
drop_reasons.blocked_by_flag:source_disputed: the published value is flagged source_disputed
drop_reasons.phase_rule:temperature_implausible: physical phase rule: the temperature is zero, a composition, or (phase equilibria) below 0.25 x the lowest element melting point
drop_reasons.gas_without_printed_pressure: ZPF region with a gas phase and no printed pressure
drop_reasons.three_phase_region_off_invariant: binary three-phase ZPF region more than 50 K from every calculated invariant of the system (a binary three-phase equilibrium is invariant)
drop_reasons.zpf_region_inert: ZPF region without any composition and without a hyperplane after E2: ESPEI 0.9.1 gives it zero driving force, so it constrains nothing (not written, not counted)
drop_reasons.duplicate_value_same_dataset: identical conditions and value under another id in the same dataset (another row or paper quoting the same value): counted once, the other id in `also_read_as`
drop_reasons.activity_out_of_range: activity outside (0, 1] (a printed scale factor such as x10^3 not applied, or a zero endpoint that gives -inf in ESPEI); excluded, not rescaled
drop_reasons.increment_not_absolute: printed quantity is an increment (H(T)-H(298), S(T)-S(298)), not the absolute property of the dataset
drop_reasons.absolute_entropy_negative: negative absolute entropy (a formation entropy or a model parameter printed as S)
drop_reasons.heat_capacity_unit_implausible: heat capacity below 5 J/K/mol-atom above 100 K (a per-gram value)
drop_reasons.formation_magnitude_implausible: formation enthalpy / Gibbs energy outside [-450, +100] kJ/mol-atom (per-formula value or unit error)
drop_reasons.mixing_magnitude_implausible: mixing enthalpy / Gibbs energy outside [-200, +100] kJ/mol-atom
drop_reasons.reference_state_not_ser: compound formation value relative to a reference phase other than the TDB's SER phase (ESPEI _FORM is relative to SER)
drop_reasons.duplicate_read_same_row: E4: the same printed table row read twice (same ORCHID row id `pid`, conditions and value); counted once, the other id kept as `also_read_as`
drop_reasons.duplicate_identical_zpf: E3: identical ZPF region (same phases, temperature and compositions) already written from another dataset (another assessment folder or another paper quoting the same invariant); kept once with every source in `also_reported_as`
